qualification.details: Officer In Charge: Graduate, minimum 05 Yrs work experience in Health Care Institutions or Managerial Positions. Medical Officer: MBBS, Min 03 Year work experience after Internship. Preferable additional qualification in medicine/surgery. Dental Officer: BDS, Min 03 Year work experience. Lab Tech: BSc (MLT) OR Matriculation/Higher Secondary/Senior Secondary (10+2) with Science from recognised institution/board and Diploma in MLT from recognised institution. Knowledge of MS Office desirable. Lab Asst: DMLT/C1 Lab Tech Course (Armed Forces). Knowledge of MS Office desirable. Nur Asst: GNM Diploma / C1 I Nursing Asst Course (Armed Forces). Knowledge of MS Office desirable. Dental Hygienist: Diploma Holder in Dental Hyg/Class I DH/DORA Course (Armed Forces). Knowledge of MS Office desirable. Pharmacist: B Pharmacy OR 10+2 with Science stream (Physics, Chemistry, Biology) from a recognized board AND Approved Diploma in Pharmacy from institute recognized by Pharmacy Council of India and registered as pharmacist under the Pharmacy Act 1948. Knowledge of MS Office desirable. Chowkidar: Class 8 & Computer Literate desirable /GD Trade (Armed Forces). Peon / MTS: Class 8 & Computer Literate desirable /GD Trade (Armed Forces). Driver: Class 8 & Computer Literate desirable/Class I MT Driver (Armed Forces) with a Civil Driving Licence. DEO/Clk: Graduate/Class I Clerk Trade (Armed forces). Min 05 years' experience. Computer course qualified. Proficiency in typing must.

salary_details.details: A total of 16 vacancies are available - 1 for Officer In Charge, 3 for Medical Officer, 1 for Dental Officer, 1 for Lab Tech, 1 for Lab Asst, 1 for Nur Asst, 2 for Dental Hygienist, 1 for Pharmacist, 1 for Chowkidar, 1 for Peon / MTS, 1 for Driver, and 2 for DEO/Clk.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ECHS Vadodara Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the ECHS Vadodara Various Contractual Staff posts is 05-10-2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the ECHS Vadodara Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 16 vacancies for various contractual staff positions announced by ECHS Vadodara.

faq.answer: Candidates need to apply through email for the ECHS Vadodara Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary range for the ECHS Vadodara contractual staff?
faq.answer: The salary for the recruited staff ranges from Rs. 21,800/- to Rs. 95,000/- per month, depending on the post.

faq.question: Q5. What are the minimum qualifications required for the Officer In Charge post?
faq.answer: For the Officer In Charge position, a Graduate degree with a minimum of 05 years of work experience in Health Care Institutions or Managerial Positions is required.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for ECHS Vadodara Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these contractual posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the ECHS Vadodara contractual staff positions will be based on an Interview.

faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Medical Officer post must have an MBBS degree with a minimum of 03 years of work experience after internship. Additional qualifications in medicine or surgery are preferable.
